name: ContactLint
description: Hosted MCP server and HTTP API for contact validation. validate_email and validate_emails (up to 50 addresses) check RFC syntax, MX and A records via DNS-over-HTTPS, disposable domains, role addresses, free providers, and domain typos without SMTP probing. validate_phone parses phone numbers and returns valid/possible flags, line type, region, and E.164 format. initialize and tools/list work without credentials; tools/call requires a ContactLint API key sent as a Bearer token (100 free checks per month).
author: ContactLint
